scripts.build:extension: tsc && vite build -c vite.extension.config.ts --mode isolated && vite build -c vite.extension.config.ts --mode main && vite build -c vite.extension.config.ts --mode background
scripts.zip:extension: npm run build:extension && npm run check:extension && cd dist-extension && zip -qr ../domnotate-extension.zip . && echo "wrote domnotate-extension.zip"
scripts.icons:extension: cd src/extension/icons && for s in 16 32 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s icon.svg -o icon-$s.png; done && rsvg-convert -w 128 -h 128 store-icon.svg -o ../../../docs/store-assets/icon-128.png && echo 'regenerated toolbar icons and the store icon'
